svg.data-spec:
title: Jobs in funcd kind: flow dir: right
[What a run executes] teal down app: App | declares its Jobs @purple job: Job | code, runtime, handler rev: Revision | one per change [/] [A run] teal down dev: Developer | funcdctl job run @purple fn: Function | ctx.job.start @purple run: JobRun | its input appr: Approval | of its preview @decision worker: Worker | calls the handler once @coral svc: Stores, Secrets, egress | as the Job @green [/]
app > job: declares job > rev: each change rev > run: pinned dev > run: creates fn > run: starts run > appr: previews appr > worker: approved or bypass worker > run: its answer worker ~> svc: reaches
